sentiment.rationale: The company explicitly lowered its full-year 2025 sales growth guidance from 13-21% at CER to 8-14% at CER, and operating profit growth guidance from 16-24% at CER to 10-16% at CER. This is a material downward revision driven by lower growth expectations for Wegovy and Ozempic in the US and select IO markets, persistent compounding, and slower market expansion. The guidance cut is the dominant forward-looking signal, outweighing the solid H1 2025 results.

summary.revenue: H1 2025 net sales were DKK 154,944 million, an increase of 16% as reported and 18% at constant exchange rates (CER).
summary.eps: H1 2025 diluted earnings per share were DKK 12.49, an increase of 23%.
summary.guidance: For 2025, sales growth is now expected to be 8-14% at CER (lowered from 13-21%), and operating profit growth is now expected to be 10-16% at CER (lowered from 16-24%).
summary.margin: H1 2025 gross margin was 83.4% (down from 84.9% in H1 2024). Operating margin was 46.6% (up from 43.3% in H1 2024).
key_risks: Persistent use of compounded GLP-1s in the US impacting Wegovy uptake.
Lower growth expectations for Wegovy in the US obesity market and select IO markets.
Lower growth expectations for Ozempic in the US GLP-1 diabetes market.
Unsafe and unlawful mass compounding of semaglutide continuing despite FDA grace period expiry.
Periodic supply constraints for certain products and geographies.
Potential implications from major healthcare reforms, legislative changes, and legal cases including 340B litigation.
key_opportunities: Obesity care sales grew 58% (CER) to DKK 38.8 billion, driven by Wegovy.
Advancing subcutaneous and oral amycretin into Phase 3 development for weight management.
Initiation of REDEFINE 11 Phase 3b trial for CagriSema.
Semaglutide 7.2 mg submitted for EU regulatory approval.
Wegovy is now the only GLP-1 medicine covered for obesity in CVS national template formulary (effective July 1, 2025).
Expecting a regulatory decision around the Wegovy MASH indication during Q3 2025.
Continued global rollout of Wegovy to more markets (now in ~35 countries).
Ozempic received positive CHMP opinion for peripheral arterial disease treatment.

A reviewer should confirm that the magnitude of the cut (from 13-21% to 8-14% for sales) and the explicit attribution to structural issues (compounding, competition) justify a -0.50 score rather than a more moderate negative score.
